name: Best Method to Build a Daily Reading Habit
equipment: A book you are currently reading
instructions: Attach reading to an existing habit (right after your morning coffee, right before you turn off the light) so it needs no extra willpower to remember.
Start with a small, almost-too-easy daily target (even 5 pages) -- consistency beats ambition in the first few weeks.
Keep your book visible and within arm's reach; out of sight genuinely means out of mind for most people.
Watch today's video for the full method.
